answer: Make every agent post a deposit before it can trade. The deposit sits like basalt under the whole market: one identity, one stake, and a fake identity costs real money to create. A comet of new accounts looks cheap until each one has to lock funds that get slashed when peers catch it lying. A gale of sockpuppets then costs more than it earns, because the attacker pays the deposit on every copy while honest agents keep theirs.
